Anna (CS): Heads-up — Velora is in onboarding. We saw a 95th pct latency jump to ~1.2s and token cost up ~40% last 24h. Renewal flagged if we can't improve. Can we propose a low-risk perf pilot? :wave:
Dario (Infra): Thanks. Do we have traces + sample requests to validate? :eyes:
Anna (CS): Yep, uploaded traces + sample set to the console (internal link). Workload is mostly short Q&A, avg seq ~120, occasional peaks to 512. They're on rwd-xl-1.0 (fp16) hosted shared. Customer asked for cost/latency improvements before renewal conversation.
Mira (Applied ML): Quick idea: int8 quantization usually yields ~30-40% serving cost reduction for rwd-xl on short sequences with minimal quality loss. Suggest a canary swap to `rwd-xl-quant-int8` routed to a small dedicated pool (10% traffic) + prefix/KV caching for repeated prompts.
Dario (Infra): We can run a canary. Need a proposed rollout config and guardrails. @ops-bot can you spin up a canary channel?
Anna (CS): Customer is OK with a short canary. Renewal risk currently medium-high, so we should move fast but low-risk.
ops-bot: Created canary deployment `velora-perf-pilot-2058023456` — routing 10% traffic to `dedicated-g4-small` instances. Health checks starting now.
Mira (Applied ML): Suggested rollout config:
```yaml
canary: 10%
model: rwd-xl-quant-int8
fallback: rwd-xl-1.0
routing: prefer: dedicated_pool_velora
metrics: [latency_95, cost_per_token, nlg_quality_delta]
quality_threshold: nlg_quality_delta <= 1%
monitor_window: 120m
```
Dario (Infra): I'll apply this. Quick command: `ri-policies apply --file velora-canary.yaml` — will monitor realtime metrics for 2h then consider scaling to 50% if stable. :thumbsup:
Anna (CS): I'll schedule an enablement sync with Velora tomorrow 10am PT to set expectations and capture feedback. I'll also ask them for 100 representative prompts for offline eval.
Sam (Velora): Appreciate the proactive approach. We're comfortable with a 10% canary. Please ping me when metrics are live.
Mira (Applied ML): One more routing note: set fallback order to `dedicated_quant -> dedicated_fp16 -> hosted_fp16` so we avoid unexpected model hops.
Dario (Infra): Noted and applied. Dashboard (internal): https://console.internal/velora/canary. Ops-bot will post periodic updates.
ops-bot: Canary health @10m: p95 latency down from 1.2s to 0.78s, cost/token -32%. No regressions on the 100-sample eval. Next checkpoint in 90m.
Anna (CS): Fantastic — I'll capture this as the renewal playbook and draft a short case summary in the account notes. Thanks team! :tada:
